what.steps: 安装包管理器（macOS 用 Homebrew，Linux 用 apt）。
安装 Zsh 与插件：自动建议、语法高亮、补全。
安装现代 CLI 工具，并部署 Catppuccin Mocha 主题的 Starship 提示符。
部署配置文件；已有配置先按时间戳备份，本机自定义写入 ~/.zshrc.local。

en.meta.description: Polar Bear sets up a fresh macOS or Linux terminal in one command: Catppuccin Starship prompt, Zsh, eza, bat, fzf, zoxide, lazygit and more.
en.hero.title: A better terminal, one command away.
en.hero.lead: Polar Bear sets up Zsh, a Catppuccin Starship prompt, and modern CLI tools — eza, bat, fzf, zoxide, lazygit, delta — on macOS and Linux. No terminal emulator to install, no config to babysit.
en.hero.value: One command turns a fresh shell into a beautiful, ready-to-use terminal.
en.hero.previewAlt: Polar Bear terminal after one-command setup: Catppuccin prompt, eza, bat, lazygit
en.hero.caption: Before → after, one command apart.
en.features.title: Core features
en.videos.title: Advanced video guides
en.videos.v1d: One line auto-clones, or review setup.sh first; --dry-run previews every step and never blocks in non-interactive runs.
en.videos.v2d: ls / cat / smart z jumps / fzf search / top monitor / fastfetch — all via the shortest aliases.
en.videos.v3d: Catppuccin prompt shows branch state, lg browses the repo, and git diff is highlighted by delta.

what.steps: Installs a package manager (Homebrew on macOS, apt on Linux).
Installs Zsh plus autosuggestions, syntax highlighting and completions.
